resumeText:
KHALID AL-HARBI
Senior Business Intelligence Analyst | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
khalid.alharbi@email.com | linkedin.com/in/khalidalharbi

SUMMARY
Business Intelligence analyst with 6 years of experience turning retail and supply-chain data into executive decisions. Built and owned the reporting stack (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Power BI) for a 40-store retail group.

EXPERIENCE

Senior BI Analyst — Alfanar Retail Group, Riyadh | Mar 2021 – Present
- Designed 25+ Power BI dashboards used weekly by C-level and 120 store managers, replacing manual Excel packs and cutting monthly reporting time from 5 days to 4 hours.
- Built ETL pipelines in SQL Server Integration Services and Python consolidating POS, inventory, and e-commerce data from 40 stores into a central warehouse (~90M rows/year).
- Modeled a star-schema data warehouse in PostgreSQL; query times for the merchandising team dropped 70%.
- Led weekly stakeholder reviews with merchandising and finance; prioritized a reporting backlog of 60+ requests.

BI Analyst — Nahdi Logistics, Jeddah | Jun 2018 – Feb 2021
- Developed SQL reports and Power BI dashboards for fleet utilization, raising truck utilization from 68% to 81% in one year.
- Automated daily KPI emails with Python and SQL, saving the operations team 15 hours/week.
- Wrote and tuned complex T-SQL (window functions, CTEs) over a 200-table operational database.

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Management Information Systems — King Saud University, 2018

CERTIFICATIONS
- Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
- Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate

SKILLS
Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, T-SQL, Python (pandas), SSIS, ETL, data warehousing, star schema, stakeholder management, Arabic (native), English (professional)
jobDescription:
Business Intelligence Analyst — Riyadh (Retail)

We are hiring a BI Analyst to own reporting for our retail operations.

Requirements:
- 4+ years in business intelligence or analytics
- Expert SQL (complex joins, window functions) on SQL Server or PostgreSQL
- Strong Power BI AND Tableau — both platforms are in active use here
- Experience building ETL pipelines and dimensional data warehouse models
- Track record of presenting insights to senior, non-technical stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree in MIS, computer science, or related field

Nice to have: Python for data automation, retail or supply-chain domain experience.
